basic_profile.bio: An aviation enthusiast and War Thunder aficionado, SkyHighPilot_92 spends most evenings and weekends engaging in virtual dogfights and sharing his experiences online. Hailing from Seattle, he works as an aerospace engineer, which feeds his passion for all things related to flight. Outside of his job, he enjoys metal casting and occasionally explores historical topics, particularly those related to ancient Rome. Single and dedicated to his hobbies, he spends his free time improving his skills in War Thunder and discussing aviation mechanics with fellow enthusiasts.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: SkyHighPilot_92 has a solid foundation in aerospace engineering, having completed a degree in this field and currently working for a major aerospace company. His expertise in aircraft dynamics and performance is self-taught from his professional work and countless hours spent analyzing flight mechanics in games like War Thunder.
